howItWorks.heading: Two functions, one seamless app
howItWorks.body: PII detection and redaction run entirely on your machine with a local model, fully offline. The original never touches a server. Only the redacted safe copy goes online.

cards.heading: Revise finalized documents
cards.body: Redact a previously finalized document, such as a signed operating agreement or trust, then tell AI to revise it, refill the confidential information automatically and offline, and send the new draft to your team or client.

cards.heading: Create memos or summaries
cards.body: Redact a final document, send the redacted copy along with your memo template to an AI chat, and tell the AI to complete the memo.

cards.heading: Evaluate KYC packages and data rooms
cards.body: Redact an entire set of documents (a KYC package, a data room, or any large collection) and let AI figure out what you need to ask for next.

cards.heading: Anything else you want AI to do
cards.body: If AI can do it, you can do it here, privately. Whatever the task, the sensitive parts stay on your device.

faq.heading: Questions, answered.
faq.body: How HushRedact handles your documents, your data, and your AI.

items.question: Does my document ever leave my computer?
items.answer: No. Detection and redaction run on your machine, offline. Your original and its sensitive text are never uploaded — no server, not even ours, sees them.

items.question: What gets redacted?
items.answer: Names, numbers, addresses, and other personal identifiers - PII and PHI. HushRedact detects them automatically with a local model, including in complex financial documents that trip up generic tools. You can review and adjust before anything leaves your device.

items.question: Which AI sees my file?
items.answer: Only the redacted version, and only the AI you choose to send it to. Your sensitive data is stripped out on-device first, so the model works on a safe copy - never the original.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: The redaction does, fully. Detecting and removing sensitive data happens on your machine with no connection required. You only go online for the AI chat step - and by then, your file is already safe.

items.question: Which documents and data types does it handle?
items.answer: Contracts, medical records, financial statements, legal filings - any document with sensitive text. It handles complex financial files that generic redaction tools can't, and detects names, numbers, PII, and PHI across them automatically.

finalCta.heading: For the work that demands confidentiality.
finalCta.body: Confidently safeguard client information and use the full power of AI, eliminating the hassle and turning hours-long projects into minutes. The original never leaves your computer.
